At the minimizer, subgradient optimality yields intersecting convex hulls of expectation vectors on extremal eigenspaces; Toeplitz-Hausdorff makes each of these pure-state expectation sets convex for k<=2. Hence unit top/bottom eigenvectors with matching observations attain spectral width, are orthogonal if positive, and Δ=2 operator-norm distance from real affine span. For scaled Pauli blocks, exact Bloch shells have radial intervals [|(1+r)p−r|,r+(1−r)p]. Overlap for p>=q yields gap ≤4r/(1+r) and q=0,p=2r/(1+r) attains it; both residual qubit blocks force affine distance 1. At r=0 pure Bloch sphere gives B=2||a||−1, not affine. Zero, one, two observations and r endpoints are included. Independent exact-rational overlap tests checked 1,386 grid pairs and witnesses; infinite quantifiers rest on analytic proof.
